title: Tenma Saki — What I Want From A Leader?〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: What I Want From A Leader?（2★）

rows.Line: Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
All we did was have a talk at the office, but I feel really tired for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A lot just happened, so I don't blame you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, a lot...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Nod*
It all began with our aspirations...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: You wish to move people's hearts, cheer them up, bring them together... And do everything you can to make the above come true.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: While they all have their minor differences, your collective desire to move people's hearts remains unchanged, yes...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Understood. It suits you all very well.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, we were asked to pick a leader.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: As pros, you'll surely be faced with a myriad of challenges and obstacles.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Of course, if anything happens, I'll be there to help. I plan on doing what I can to keep you moving in the right direction.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: However, I'm also an employee of this record company. My job is to make your band and music as marketable as possible.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: In other words, the onus is on you to keep your band together...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Not only that, we got to meet the president of Solis Records, and he's going to hear us play!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: When we put it all together like this, so much happened so fast...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Still, I'm really glad Honami volunteered to be our leader right then and there.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You had a good look on your face then.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
O-Oh, really...?
I'm starting to feel a little embarrassed.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, I was only able to raise my hand because all of you, including Mr. Shindo, encouraged me by saying that I'd do a good job.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Which is why I plan on doing everything I can for this band.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But that doesn't make you any less amazing! I mean, you've already done something really cool for us!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, are you talking about when she decided to have Mr. Ota hear us play?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We decided to go pro because we want as many people as possible to hear our music...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And if this is our chance to do that...then we accept.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's okay with all of you, right...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You didn't just ask if it was okay with us.
You asserted yourself like a real leader!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, you sounded pretty confident about your decision as our leader that time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I agree. It was a good reminder of how amazing a person you really are, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: N-No, I just...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What's this?
Is our fearless leader blushing?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You're in for a scolding if you keep teasing our leader like that, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hear that? These two are apparently asking for it. What are you gonna do, leader?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Please, everyone...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If you don't stop, I'll have no choice but to make you all write letters of apology!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Letters of apology?
Aren't you supposed to be scolding us?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, Saki, you'll be writing two for me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait! This is really happening?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, Hona, I'm sorry!
Please just scold me like you would normally!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Normally...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Honami
rows.Line:
Haha.
Hehe.
